In advanced non‐squamous non‐small cell lung cancer (non‐sq NSCLC), companion diagnostic testing (CDx) identifies actionable driver alterations and guides initial targeted therapy. However, disease progression inevitably occurs through acquired resistance, including activation of bypass signaling pathways. Thyroid cancer is the most common endocrine malignancy and is increasing rapidly worldwide. While most thyroid cancers can be treated successfully, a substantial group of patients faces poor outcomes when their tumors become refractory to radioactive iodine, when resistance develops to targeted agents, or when they develop the most aggressive form known as anaplastic thyroid cancer.
